name: claude-leaf
description: Read, edit and annotate markdown in a pane beside the chat, drawn like leaf: headings, tables, code frames, mermaid as box art, a TOC, search, a file picker and leaf's themes. Notes on lines go to the prompt box. Needs function hooks (early access).

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: catppuccin-mocha, catppuccin-macchiato, catppuccin-frappe, catppuccin-latte, ocean, arctic, forest or solarized-dark. Empty: LEAF_THEME, then theme in ~/.config/leaf/config.toml, then catppuccin-mocha.
